note.question: How does the inspection, even an imperfect one, change the signaling game’s structure and incentivizes the seller whose product is likely authentic to sell through the platform?
note.overview: The model considers a customer-to-customer (C2C) platform that provides an inspection service. Uncertain about product authenticity, a seller sells a product through the platform. Before purchasing, a buyer obtains a signal of the product authenticity from the product’s price set by the seller.
